mlss-lactate-range.label: Blood lactate at the maximal lactate steady state (MLSS)
mlss-lactate-range.value: about 1.5–7 mmol·L⁻¹ between people, average about 3.7

mlss-test-criterion.label: Standard MLSS test
mlss-test-criterion.value: 4–5 constant-load bouts of 30 min on separate days; MLSS is the highest load at which blood lactate rises by no more than 1 mmol·L⁻¹ from minute 10 to minute 30

mmss-vo2max.label: Heavy/severe boundary (maximal metabolic steady state) as a share of VO2max

ftp-factor.label: FTP from a 20-min field test
ftp-factor.value: 95% of the average power of a 20-min time trial
